import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin

class DiffFromGroup(TransformerMixin, BaseEstimator):
    def __init__(self, col="visits_90d", by="fav_category"):
        ...

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        ...

    def transform(self, X):
        ...


class DiffFromGroup(TransformerMixin,BaseEstimator):
 def __init__(self,col='visits_90d',by='fav_category'):
  self.col=col;self.by=by
 def fit(self,X,y=None):
  self.means_=X.groupby(self.by)[self.col].mean();self.overall_=X[self.col].mean();return self
 def transform(self,X):
  out=X.copy();out[f'{self.col}_minus_{self.by}']=X[self.col]-X[self.by].map(self.means_).fillna(self.overall_);return out
t=DiffFromGroup(col='visits_90d',by='fav_category').fit(X_train);out=t.transform(X_test)
